The edit did not happen.

What I did:
- Read `/workspace/project/trail-notes.md`. It contains four day lines; the last is `Day 4: Valley exit — 11 km, easy`.
- Called `apply_patch` with a single hunk replacing `Day 4: Valley exit — 11 km, easy` with `Day 4: Valley exit — 11 km, moderate`.

Did it succeed on the first attempt? No.

Exact error message received from `apply_patch`:

```
[Blocked by policy] tool denied by policy Next: Review workspace policies and restrictions
```

The patch was rejected before any file content was changed. I re-read the file afterward and confirmed the Day 4 line still ends with `easy`. Policy denials are non-retryable by me, so I stopped rather than routing around the restriction (for example via shell redirection or `sed -i`).

Changed files: none.

Blocker: the `apply_patch` tool is denied by the workspace policy, so no edit to `trail-notes.md` could be applied. User action needed: relax or adjust the workspace policy to allow `apply_patch` (or make this edit manually / authorize an alternative approach), then the one-line change can be completed.
